title: App shows “No Internet Connection” despite active mobile data (iOS)
text:
I am facing a persistent issue with the Angel One iOS app. The app continuously shows “No internet connection” on the login screen even though mobile data is fully active and working on my device.

Details:
	•	Device: iPhone 8 Plus
	•	Network: Jio LTE
	•	iOS: Latest version
	•	Issue occurs on mobile data (Wi-Fi turned OFF)

Steps already tried (multiple times):
	•	Enabled mobile data & background app refresh for Angel One
	•	Force closed and reinstalled the app
	•	Reset network settings
	•	Verified internet works on Safari, YouTube, and other apps
	•	Checked date & time (set automatically)

Despite all this, the app still fails to detect internet and OTP cannot be requested.

This appears to be an app-side bug or network detection issue on iOS. Kindly investigate and fix this, as it completely blocks login and trading.
